title: Let's tour my cottage...
en: hello everyone and welcome to my little corner of the world today i wanted to do a cottage tour since so many people have requested to see inside my home when i first moved in i took some time to make it feel like a little piece of wonderland

that i could escape to after work and unleash my creativity for me what makes my cottage special is all the tiny little details from making pressed flower art from my walls to even my little tea collection that i have been growing this year and of course my mini houseplants and miniatures even though it is a one-room cottage it feels like the perfect size for me i think that even if i had a family in

the future i wouldn't want a place that much bigger it is so easy to keep clean and tidy and that makes me happy since i'm capable of creating enormous messes especially in relation to my art projects you can see here that i've been painting the walls i find it a wonderful way to personalize the space you may also notice that i'm obsessed with books i get them mostly secondhand but i did used to work at a bookstore if i could only recommend one to you it would be the boy

the mole the fox and the horse it is a hybrid between a children's book and an adult book and it is beautiful to those who have inquired about my wardrobe pretty much all of it has been thrifted or gifted to me by family members my bathroom actually doesn't have a sink with running water but i get along just well with a pitcher and basin it's amazing how over time with living this way i've become accustomed to it and i don't really need anything else to feel comfortable my boyfriend brings me crystals that he

has found out on his hikes in the mountains and i love to decorate my space with them of course my favorite part of my cottage is my art desk it is where i like to sit and think up all my new ideas for future projects that is where i also keep some of my favorite old books it is so wonderful to hold a piece of history in your hands as you can see this cottage is small and simple i love to fill it with little unusual pieces that i find at thrift stores or natural things that i find around my property i have so many plans to paint the walls even more and
i hope you enjoyed looking around do do i decided not to do a garden tour since many of my plants have been taken by the autumn frost however i have many plants next year to
grow a multitude of herbs and flowers and i will definitely share it with you then me
zh: 大家好，欢迎来到我今天的世界小角落，我想做一次小屋之旅，因为当我第一次搬进来时，很多人要求看看我家的内部，我花了一些时间让它感觉像是一个仙境
我可以在下班后逃离这里，释放我的创造力，让我的小屋与众不同的是所有的小细节，从在墙上制作压花艺术到今年我一直在种植的小茶收藏，当然还有我的迷你室内植物和微型模型，尽管它是一间单间小屋，但对我来说感觉尺寸完美，我认为即使我有一个家庭在
未来我不想要一个更大的地方，它很容易保持干净整洁，这让我很高兴，因为我有能力制造巨大的混乱，特别是与我的艺术项目相关的东西，你可以在这里看到，我一直在粉刷墙壁，我发现这是个性化空间的好方法，你可能还会注意到，我对书很着迷，我买的大多是二手书，但我曾经在书店工作，如果我只能向你推荐一本，那就是那个男孩
狐狸和马的鼹鼠 它是一本儿童书和成人书的混合体，对于那些询问我的衣柜的人来说，它很漂亮，几乎所有的东西都是家人节省或送给我的礼物。我的浴室实际上没有带自来水的水槽，但我和水罐和脸盆相处得很好，令人惊奇的是，随着时间的推移，我已经习惯了这种方式，我真的不需要任何其他东西来感到舒服，我的男朋友给我带来了他的水晶。
我在山里徒步旅行时发现了这一点，我喜欢用它们来装饰我的空间，当然，我小屋中我最喜欢的部分是我的艺术桌，我喜欢坐在那儿思考我对未来项目的所有新想法，我还保存一些我最喜欢的旧书，手里拿着一段历史真是太棒了，因为你可以看到这间小屋小而简单，我喜欢用我在旧货店找到的不寻常的小东西或我在我的房子周围发现的自然事物来填充它，我有很多计划把墙壁粉刷得更多，
我希望你喜欢环顾四周，我决定不去花园旅游了吗，因为我的许多植物都被秋霜带走了，但明年我还有很多植物可以去
种植多种草药和花卉，我一定会与你分享，然后是我
